up: Retrieve exact IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against the human sodium-dependent noradrenaline transporter. The query must include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, target name, and target organism. Filter results to only include rows where a canonical SMILES is present and at least one citation (PubMed ID or DOI) is available. The target is identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL222. Ensure the activity relation is '=' and units are 'nM'.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL222'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL)
